$comment: Command registry — the single place an agent looks up how to run things.
Point AGENTS.md at this file with: 'Read agent-commands.json before
choosing commands. Do not invent commands.'
Why it exists: agents guess commands from package.json scripts and get them
subtly wrong (whole-repo test instead of scoped, wrong package manager, a
script that was renamed). One registry with the real invocations kills that
Rules: every value must be a command that actually runs today. Use null for
capabilities this repo does not have — an absent key reads as an oversight,
an explicit null reads as a decision. Use <angle-brackets> for the argument
notes: Use this file before choosing validation commands.
Do not invent scripts; use package.json or this registry.
Prefer scoped commands over whole-repo ones.
